code: import os import json import time import random import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 (用户指定) START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 HEADLESS = True # 是否无头模式（不显示浏览器窗口） TIMEOUT = 30000 # 超时时间 (ms) # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): """确保目录存在""" if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_date(date_str): """清洗日期格式，统一为 YYYY-MM-DD""" if not date_str: return "" # 处理 YYYY/MM/DD date_str = date_str.replace('/', '-').strip() # 提取 YYYY-MM-DD match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2})', date_str) if match: return match.group(1) return "" def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径图片/链接转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): # 忽略 base64 图片 if not img['src'].startswith('data:'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 (附件下载等) for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): href = a['href'] if not href.startswith(('http', 'javascript:', 'mailto:', '#')): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, href) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def save_results(articles, output_dir): """保存结果为JSON""" ensure_dir(output_dir) timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"\n[Success] 结果已保存到: {output_path}") print(f"共采集 {len(articles)} 条符合时间范围的数据") # ================= 核心逻辑 ================= def extract_detail_page(page, url): """提取详情页内容""" try: print(f"正在抓取详情: {url}") page.goto(url, timeout=TIMEOUT, wait_until="domcontentloaded") # 随机等待，模拟人类行为 page.wait_for_timeout(random.randint(1000, 2000)) content_html = page.content() soup = BeautifulSoup(content_html, 'html.parser') # 尝试定位正文容器 # 常见选择器：.TRS_Editor, .article-content, #content, .content, .detail_content content_selectors = [ '.TRS_Editor', '.article_content', '.content', '#content', '.detail_content', '.xl_content', 'div[style*="font-size"]' # 兜底 ] content_body = "" for selector in content_selectors: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element: content_body = str(element) break # 如果还没找到，尝试找字数最多的 div if not content_body: divs = soup.find_all('div') if divs: content_body = str(max(divs, key=lambda d: len(d.get_text(strip=True)))) # 提取来源和作者（如果有） source = "" author = "" # 尝试从常见的元数据区域提取 meta_text = soup.get_text() source_match = re.search(r'来源[：:]\s*(\S+)', meta_text) if source_match: source = source_match.group(1) return clean_html_content(content_body, url), source, author except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 详情页抓取失败 {url}: {e}") return "", "", "" def crawl_news(): """主爬虫逻辑""" articles = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=HEADLESS, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() print(f"开始访问列表页: {TARGET_URL}") try: page.goto(TARGET_URL, timeout=TIMEOUT, wait_until="networkidle") except Exception as e: print(f"页面加载超时或失败，尝试继续: {e}") page_num = 1 stop_crawling = False while not stop_crawling: print(f"\n--- 正在处理第 {page_num} 页 ---") # 等待列表元素加载 try: page.wait_for_selector('.rightListContent', timeout=10000) except: print("未找到列表元素，可能已无数据或页面结构变化") break # 解析当前页列表 html = page.content() soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') # 根据HTML结构分析，列表项在 .rightListContent 中 items = soup.select('.rightListContent') if not items: print("当前页未提取到数据") break current_page_items = [] for item in items: try: # 提取日期 date_elem = item.select_one('.rightListTime') if not date_elem: continue raw_date = date_elem.get_text(strip=True) pub_date = clean_date(raw_date) if not pub_date: continue # === 时间范围过滤逻辑 === # 1. 如果日期晚于结束时间 (例如 2026年)，跳过该条，继续往下找 if pub_date > END_DATE: continue # 2. 如果日期早于开始时间 (例如 2025-11月)，说明后续都是旧数据，停止爬虫 if pub_date < START_DATE: print(f"发现日期 {pub_date} 早于开始时间 {START_DATE}，停止翻页") stop_crawling = True break # 3. 在范围内，提取详情 link_elem = item.select_one('.rightListImport a') if not link_elem: continue title = link_elem.get_text(strip=True) href = link_elem.get('href') full_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, href) print(f"发现目标: [{pub_date}] {title}") current_page_items.append({ "title": title, "date": pub_date, "sourceUrl": full_url, "id": str(len(articles) + len(current_page_items) + 1) }) except Exception as e: print(f"解析单条数据出错: {e}") continue # 将当前页符合条件的加入总列表 # 注意：这里暂时只存了元数据，详情页内容稍后统一抓取或边抓边存 # 为了效率，这里先收集元数据，最后统一抓详情（或者在下面直接抓） # 考虑到稳定性，我们先把元数据加入待抓取列表 for item in current_page_items: articles.append(item) if stop_crawling: break # === 翻页逻辑 === # 检查是否有下一页按钮 # 根据HTML结构，下一页按钮可能是 next_btn = page.locator('.pageNext') # 检查按钮是否存在且可见 if next_btn.count() > 0 and next_btn.is_visible(): # 检查是否是最后一页（有些网站最后一页next按钮会隐藏或变灰，这里假设如果存在就能点） # 记录当前第一条新闻的标题，用于判断翻页是否成功 first_title_before = "" first_item = page.query_selector('.rightListContent .rightListImport a') if first_item: first_title_before = first_item.inner_text() print("点击下一页...") try: next_btn.click() # 等待页面刷新：检测第一条新闻标题变化 # 或者等待网络空闲 page.wait_for_timeout(2000) # 基础等待 # 简单的翻页成功检测 first_item_after = page.query_selector('.rightListContent .rightListImport a') if first_item_after and first_item_after.inner_text() == first_title_before: print("翻页后内容未变，可能已达最后一页或翻页失败") # 再次尝试等待 page.wait_for_timeout(3000) page_num += 1 except Exception as e: print(f"翻页操作失败: {e}") break else: print("未找到下一页按钮或已达最后一页") break print(f"\n列表采集完成，共 {len(articles)} 条。开始采集详情页内容...") # === 采集详情页内容 === for i, article in enumerate(articles): print(f"[{i+1}/{len(articles)}] 处理: {article['title']}") content, source, author = extract_detail_page(page, article['sourceUrl']) article['content'] = content article['summary'] = BeautifulSoup(content, 'html.parser').get_text(strip=True)[:200] + "..." if content else "" if source: article['source'] = source if author: article['author'] = author # 简单的防封禁延时 time.sleep(random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)) browser.close() return articles def main(): print("=== 中国债券信息网新闻爬虫启动 ===") print(f"目标时间范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") try: articles = crawl_news() if articles: save_results(articles, OUTPUT_DIR) else: print("未找到符合条件的新闻数据。") except Exception as e: print(f"爬虫运行出错: {e}") import traceback traceback.print_exc() if __name__ == "__main__": main()
